name: Schedules (kind)
_how: Detect: is this region-v2 table (or an uncovered Textract table) a schedule worth proposing? The structure score is region v2's own (so L1 keep decisions are untouched; p = σ(−1.2 + 4·structure + 1·textract + 1·schedule-word + .5·rows/6)), a bare Textract table passes only with SCHEDULE-like words (low prior). Name: one class per vocabulary kind, each logit = −3 + 3·header + 2·above + 2.5·columns + 1.5·body + 1.2·CSI division share + 2·CSI section share + 1·sheet discipline + .8·sheet title − 1.5·negatives; values are 1−exp(−Σw·sqrt(min(3,n))/saturation). Header phrases are the strongest single signal, column-header words the most discriminating without a title. Winner needs p ≥ .5 and a .1 margin, else 'Other schedule' shown with the derived header name.
